description: E-433 (D-160; release-artifact.md §Component 7 'Events'): one row per row of the event table, driven by tests/unit/waiting-signal.test.mjs through rein_ws_dispatch with a stub tmux on PATH. `state` is the per-pane waiting-call id file before the event (null: absent; "": present, no id). `expect` is the tmux call the event makes: set:<value>, clear, signals:on, signals:off (after a clear), or none; `after` is the id file afterwards (null: absent).

rows.label: PermissionRequest sets permission and keeps the call's id
PermissionRequest without an id sets permission
Notification permission_prompt is the backstop: sets when nothing is recorded
Notification permission_prompt keeps an earlier set (its time and id)
Notification of another type does nothing
PreToolUse of any other tool does nothing
PostToolUse of the waiting call clears
PostToolUse of a sibling call leaves the open prompt set
PostToolUse with no wait recorded makes no tmux call
PostToolUse clears a wait recorded without an id (bound 2 over precision)
PostToolUseFailure of the waiting call clears
Stop clears (bound 2: no wait outlives the turn)
SessionStart clears and turns the signal on
SessionEnd clears and turns the signal off
